metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve apparel for a polished, professional look. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Set in sleeve construction offers a clean, tailored shoulder line that sits naturally on the body, making it a preferred choice for corporate uniforms and professional settings. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, set in sleeves provide a structured fit that layers easily under jackets. This construction is common in performance tees, 1/4-zip pullovers, and classic crewnecks from brands like The North Face and Champion. For safety managers or HR directors ordering company apparel, set in sleeve garments ensure a consistent, polished appearance across all body types.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve apparel including men's and women's jackets, tees, and sweatshirts with structured shoulder seams
